{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for missing values in 'site'
print("Missing values in 'site':", data['site'].isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicate rows
print("Duplicate rows:", data.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of sites
print("Site distribution:\n", data['site'].value_counts())

# Check the response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = data.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by site:\n", response_rate_by_site)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
highest_response_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_response_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"Site with highest response rate: {highest_response_site}")
print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_response_rate}")"}
